Name: Si's Simple Essentials Farm
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
Just a simple farm map with some useful features.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]10 hardwood stumps that respawn daily[/*]
[*]A quarry area that spawns stone, ore, and geodes[/*]
[*]Blue grass[/*]
[*]Forageables[/*]
[*]All ground tiles (including grass tiles) are tillable[/*]
[*]Space for all vanilla buildings plus more[/*]
[*]Mountain fish in the ponds[/*]
[*]Starting gift is 15 parsnip seeds, 3 strawberry seeds, and a garden pot[/*]
[*]Starting farmhouse includes a calendar and a dresser[/*]
[*]A config option to toggle whether green rain weeds/trees appear on the farm. Set to 'true' to allow green rain debris and 'false' to prevent it (default true)[/*]
[*]Config options to toggle the hardwood stumps, the quarry, and each of the ponds[/*]
[*]Should be compatible with all recolors[/*]
[/list][b]Instructions[/b]
Download this mod's files and unzip into your Mods folder. Select this farm in the farm selection menu when creating your save.
This mod is meant to be added prior to creating a new save. If you'd like to change your farm type in a pre-existing save, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873]Easy Farm Switcher[/url].

[b]Future Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom world map appearance (currently looks like the standard farm on the world map)[/*]
[/list][b]Translations[/b]
No AI translations please. This mod is i18n-compatible! Translators, you can either send me a translation file to be included in the main mod files, or maintain your own separate mod translation. If you choose to have your own separate translation mod, please ensure it requires my mod to be downloaded (either as a dependency or as a file replacer), and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Bug Reports
[/b]If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please post them in the Bugs tab [b]with a link to your SMAPI log [/b]as well as an image of the issue if possible. Include a SMAPI log even if you don't see any errors in the SMAPI window. Instructions for generating a SMAPI log are here: [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]
